about.text: Welcome to our boutique complex, nestled near a pine forest, just 1.5 km from the sea near Albena. We offer 15 cozy rooms, event halls, a relaxation area, gym, and a pool surrounded by greenery. On the terrace restaurant, exquisite dishes and an unforgettable atmosphere await you.

testimonial.1.text: Our stay at this hotel was extremely pleasant and memorable. The hotel is cozy and exceptionally well-maintained, creating a sense of home comfort and artistry, thanks to the talented artist and designer Maria Ilieva. The service was of the highest level — the staff were always smiling and ready to help with our every wish. I was especially impressed by their friendliness and professionalism. We would gladly return and I recommend this hotel to anyone seeking peace and excellent service.
testimonial.1.name: Denitsa
testimonial.2.text: A cozy little hotel, right at the roundabout at the entrance of Albena resort, heading towards Dobrich. A convenient and pleasant place where you can stay for a vacation away from the resort's hustle, yet close to it and able to use its beaches. There is also a pool you can use if you prefer to stay away from the resort crowds. A place suitable for relaxation and business meetings, with good service, welcoming staff, a fine restaurant, and great food.
testimonial.2.name: Ivan
testimonial.3.text: The hotel interior is gorgeous, creating a very pleasant atmosphere. Clean, tidy, and the staff is responsive in everything. Kind and smiling people. At breakfast, there were very tasty and fresh fruits, fresh food, delicious coffee. Clean pool, table tennis, and a basketball court in the shade under the outdoor trees. A wonderful place for both children and adults! The water park is very close, and the hotel offers shuttle service to the beach — my children and I really loved it! We had a cozy room with a wonderful mirror that creates the feeling that the sun is shining over your bed.
testimonial.3.name: Diana
